frame_row: Document-grounded proposal; no RTL hierarchy is asserted.

label: u_cva6
(cva6)
MODIFY
blocks.function: Uses a license-preserving local config with CVXIF disabled; the licensed shell routes boot address, D-cache ownership and tagged probes. Pipeline, MMU and I-cache submodules remain unchanged.

label: u_cva6_hpdcache_subsystem
(cva6_hpdcache_subsystem)
MODIFY
blocks.function: Splits the cacheable D-cache path from I-cache/device traffic and connects ownership grant plus tagged probe/data response paths to the coherence fabric.

label: u_cva6_icache
(cva6_icache)
REUSE
blocks.function: Stores instruction lines and services instruction fetches for the hart.

label: u_cva6_hpdcache_wrapper
(cva6_hpdcache_wrapper)
MODIFY
blocks.function: Carries CPU request IDs and hart identity across the new permission request/grant and tagged probe interfaces.

label: u_hpdcache
(hpdcache)
MODIFY
blocks.function: Adds per-line I/S/E/M state, permission-before-fill/upgrade sequencing, same-line exclusion and full-line tagged probe service.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_tile_coh_adapter
(m_vlsit_riscv_tile_coh_adapter)
NEW
blocks.function: Adapts source request IDs and line operations to the CCU; gates D-cache completion on ownership grants and associates tagged probe responses.

interfaces.name: CVA6/cache subsystem
interfaces.signals: Request, response, fetch/data payload and completion; exact record fields depend on the pinned CVA6 source.

interfaces.name: Instruction cache path
interfaces.signals: Instruction fetch request/return data; exact RTL fields are source-version dependent.

interfaces.name: HPDcache wrapper path
interfaces.signals: Data-cache requester traffic and responses; types and outstanding limits must match the selected config.

interfaces.name: HPDcache internal path
interfaces.signals: Requester commands, response data, write data and cache-maintenance status.

interfaces.name: Tile ownership request/grant
interfaces.signals: Read-shared or write-unique permission request, physical line address, original requester ID, grant state and line data; exact widths are frozen in the port plan.

interfaces.name: Tagged two-phase probe
interfaces.signals: PREPARE returns stable MESI state and any dirty data without changing state; COMMIT changes target state; ABORT restores the old state. Missing COMMIT ACK holds line lock/slot until reset.

interfaces.name: Per-hart platform interrupts
interfaces.signals: Per-hart interrupt classes defined in Section 6.

interfaces.name: Shared boot address
interfaces.signals: One runtime 64-bit input is held through reset release and fanned out to boot_addr_i of each active hart; software may branch on mhartid.

interfaces.name: Tile coherence boundary
interfaces.signals: Logical cacheable request/response interface; names, widths and cycle timing await source integration.

interfaces.name: Hart performance event taps
interfaces.signals: Candidate CVA6 performance events and cache events; event map is an open dependency.

legend_note: Planned wrapper/instance names are VLSIT proposals, not names observed in a pinned RTL tree. CVXIF is disabled in the licensed local CVA6 config copy; no CVXIF port is exposed at the cluster boundary. Status codes: REUSE = upstream RTL reused; REUSE* = reuse candidate pending compatibility checks; MODIFY = source adaptation, wrapper, or macro binding; NEW = VLSIT RTL to design; GENERATED = CSR RTL from the selected generator. All proposed blocks are dashed because this cluster has no pinned integrated RTL yet.
